I visited this place after seeing the photos on Google and reading that it is “home boarding.” Based on the pictures and description, I genuinely believed my cat would be staying in a home-like environment. Unfortunately, the reality was completely different.
This is not home boarding. It is a pet shop setup. Two cats were inside, and they clearly looked stressed and unhappy.
I was then taken to the second shop, which was far worse. The smell was unbearable — strong urine and feces odor to the extent that it was very difficult to stand there. It was evident that hygiene and regular cleaning are not being maintained.
The so-called cat boarding area is actually a bunker/storage-type space above the shop, not a proper room. The stairs leading up were filthy, the entire area was extremely dirty, and there were multiple cages kept in a corner, all unclean. It felt like a godown, not a place where living animals are meant to stay.
If someone is charging for cat boarding, the bare minimum expectation is a clean, safe, and dedicated space — not cages kept in a storage area with poor ventilation and zero hygiene.
As a responsible cat parent, I could not imagine leaving my cat here even for a minute. I strongly urge others not to rely on online photos or the term “home boarding” and to personally visit the place before making any decision.
